subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The students arranged an open _______ on the topic of pandemics and social life after them.
solution:
The **correct answer **is "**Option 4: debate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "debate"** refers to a formal discussion on a particular topic where opposing arguments are put forward, fitting perfectly within the context of the sentence.
 
• An **"open debate"** implies that different or opposing views were allowed and encouraged, which aligns with the context of a discussion on pandemics.
 
• None of the other options make sense in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is **"Option 4: debate".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An** "open drought"** doesn't make sense in relation to arranging an event by students.
 
• **"Open debase"** has no clear meaning, and the term 'debase' typically implies the action of reducing something in quality or value.
 
• **"Open debt" **would not make sense contextually as it isn't an event that can be arranged.
